manifest.description: Move the CoreXY gantry to an absolute X/Y/Z position inside the 115 x 60 x 60 cm workspace. Origin 0,0,0 is the back-bottom-left corner.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Controller resolved from the Hardware Map for the CoreXY gantry routine.

inputs.label: X Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target X position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 115 cm.

inputs.label: Y Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target Y position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 60 cm.

inputs.label: Z Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target Z position in cm from the back-bottom-left origin. Range: 0 to 60 cm.

inputs.label: Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric target motor speed for the move.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: On-the-fly Calibration
inputs.description: When enabled, moves that end within 3 cm of a limit switch probe that switch and compare the observed position against calibration.

inputs.label: Max Calibration Difference (steps)
inputs.description: Maximum allowed on-the-fly limit-switch position error before a full recalibration is triggered.

advanced_inputs.label: X Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the X axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the X axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the Y axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the Y axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Motor A Step Multiplier
advanced_inputs.description: Multiplier applied to CoreXY motor A step pulses. Use 2.0 when motor A needs twice as many step pulses as motor B for X-only motion.

advanced_inputs.label: Limit Switch Layout
advanced_inputs.description: Choose whether the XY gantry uses 2 shared/home switches or 4 end-stop switches.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Z Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the single Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Z Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the single Z axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Legacy Z Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Compatibility alias for old dual-Z workflows. Single-Z setups reuse the Z step pin.

advanced_inputs.label: Legacy Z Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Compatibility alias for old dual-Z workflows. Single-Z setups reuse the Z direction pin.

advanced_inputs.label: Z Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Z minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Z Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Z maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Legacy Z Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Compatibility alias for old dual-Z workflows. Single-Z setups reuse the Z min limit pin.

advanced_inputs.label: Legacy Z Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Compatibility alias for old dual-Z workflows. Single-Z setups reuse the Z max limit pin.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the XY move completes.

hardware_devices.name: Z Axis Motor
hardware_devices.notes: Single Z axis motor. Stable legacy ID kept for compatibility.

firmware_requirements.protocol: Serial commands: PING, SET XY PINS <coreAStep> <coreADir> <coreBStep> <coreBDir> <motorAStepMultiplier>, SET XY LIMITS <mode> <xMin> <xMax> <yMin> <yMax>, SET Z PINS <zStep> <zDir> <zStep> <zDir>, SET Z LIMITS <mode> <zMin> <zMax> <zMin> <zMax>, MOVE XYZ <xCm> <yCm> <zCm> <speedRpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond> <onTheFlyFlag> <maxDiffSteps>.
firmware_requirements.description: Firmware routine required by Move Gantry XYZ on a CoreXY gantry with a single Z axis.

manifest.protocol: Serial commands: PING, SET XY PINS <coreAStep> <coreADir> <coreBStep> <coreBDir> <motorAStepMultiplier>, SET XY LIMITS <mode> <xMin> <xMax> <yMin> <yMax>, SET Z PINS <zStep> <zDir> <zStep> <zDir>, SET Z LIMITS <mode> <zMin> <zMax> <zMin> <zMax>, MOVE XYZ <xCm> <yCm> <zCm> <speedRpm> <trapezoidFlag> <accelerationRpmPerSecond> <onTheFlyFlag> <maxDiffSteps>.
manifest.notes: CoreXY gantry movement. Origin 0,0,0 is the back-bottom-left corner. X range is 0-115 cm, Y range is 0-60 cm, and Z range is 0-60 cm.
